name: get_followups
description: Look up networking contacts by their scheduled follow-up date. Use this read-only tool when asked who is due on a date or through a date. Results include each matching contact's name, company, next action, and due date. The query uses due dates regardless of completion status.

include_earlier.description: Set to true for follow-ups due on or before the date. Omit or set to false for that date alone.
